services.name: Balloon Rides
services.desc: Embark on a once-in-a-lifetime journey with a hot air balloon ride that takes you above it all. Float effortlessly over rolling hills, winding rivers, and wide-open landscapes as the world unfolds beneath you. Capture breathtaking panoramic views and experience the thrill of flight from a whole new perspective. Whether you’re chasing adventure or simply looking to escape the ordinary, this is the ride you’ll never

includes: Post flight celebration with champagne or sparkling cider and truffles
gap: Exact pricing not stated on the pages provided
blurb: Guests meet at the Essex Resort and Spa and are transported to the launch site. The flight lasts about 60 minutes in the air, with the entire experience taking 3-4 hours including safety briefing, inflation, flight, landing, and post-flight celebration. Flights occur only at sunrise and sunset for safety reasons.
extraNote: No deposit required; payment due after flight · Cancellations must be made 7 days prior to avoid charges · Cancellation charges: 25% 3-7 days prior, 50% 48-72 hours, 75% 24-48 hours, 100% less than 24 hours · Weather cancellations result in no charge and rescheduling offered · Front door of the Essex Resort and Spa, 70 Essex Way, Essex, Vermont 05452
